quotes.author: Rosemary A.
quotes.text: This cruise was so fun! The food was delicious. We had a choice of Salmon, Short Ribs, Roasted Chicken or Eggplant. Live music and plenty of time for dancing. The cruise coasted along smoothly offering beautiful views.

quotes.author: Finita S.
quotes.text: I have cruised with Cornucopia many times. The food is usually buffet style and very good, sitting tables of six to eight. Great sit down dinner with live music for dancing. A very enjoyable day or evening.

quotes.author: Tarnisha S.
quotes.text: The staff are pleasant and attentive. We were served appetizers, pasta, salad, main entrée, and dessert. There was a live DJ and music. The scenery was pleasant. We had a fabulous time, will do again!

quotes.author: Ellen S.
quotes.text: It went beyond my expectations. The boat is wonderful, the dining area is very elegant and the service was great. Good music and good company. I thoroughly enjoyed the whole evening!
